game.name: The Simpsons: Hit & Run
game.rules:
## RULES

- Permanent video proof must be provided for all runs. This means Twitch past broadcasts will not be accepted as they expire after a set amount of time (note that Twitch highlights are still fine).
- Timeskip and changing the game's frame rate during runs is not allowed in Restricted categories. 
- Do not change single core priority on/off during runs.
- **All PC runs are subjected to displaying an FPS counter from listed time gates displayed in each main categories rules. Otherwise FPS counter is required for all podium submissions** (1st-4th).
- All runs on console must be ran using the disc. This means no runs with the game being loaded directly from the hard drive via a modded console.
- You may not use skips that rely on hardware to deload game areas.
- Use of in-game cheats is banned.

## TIMING

- Both LRT (time without loads) and RTA (time with loads) should be provided for submissions.
- Timing starts when pressing New Game or loading a tutorial save with Resume Game. If a tutorial save is used, the timer should start at 40.9 seconds (done automatically by the autosplitter). If you are using tutorial save on console, you must start the timer at 39.34.
- Timing ends when the icons reappear on the minimap after the last mission is completed. If you are running 100% and do not end on a mission, timing ends when 100% is acquired.
- Submitting LRT (time without loads) is not required for submissions, but it is preferred, as it is the main timing method used.
- If you are submitting a console run, leave LRT blank.
- All runs submitting LRT should show proof of LRT from using the LiveSplit timer and comparing against Game Time.
- Milliseconds should not be submitted for categories other than Bonus Game. 

## MODIFICATION WHITELIST

- A whitelist of mods that are acceptable for runs can be found here: https://www.speedrun.com/shar/thread/e9geo. All other modifications are banned.

categories.name: All Story Missions
categories.rules:
## ALL STORY MISSIONS

- Complete all story missions in order.
- **Do not** skip missions using the popup seen after failing a mission 6+ times.
- Pre-run setups including disabling jump cameras and methods that skip the opening camera pan are **not** allowed.
- Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game window, is **not** allowed.
- Framerate per second must be displayed for sub 1:25 runs. This framerate per second should not exceed 200 FPS.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
## ANY%

- Finish the game as fast as possible.
- Skipping missions is permitted.
- Skipping the introductory camera pan, done by using a pre-run setup, is banned.
- Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game window, is only allowed in **Any% unrestricted**.
- Framerate per second must be displayed for sub 55 runs. This framerate per second should not exceed 200 FPS in restricted Any%.

## 100%

- Reach 100% completion of the game.
- Game completion percentage, seen in the main menu scrapbook, should be shown at the end of the run. Showing the sticker which appears on the scrapbook is also valid. If you forget to include this in your video, it is recommended you timestamp points in the run which show you have collected everything.
- Framerate per second must be displayed for sub 3:10 runs. This framerate per second should not exceed 200 FPS.
- Time spent showing this percentage is not included in the timing.
- Timing ends upon reaching 100% completion, whether this be through a mission, race or collectable.
- Pre-run setups including disabling jump cameras and methods that skip the opening camera pan are **not** allowed.
- Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game window, is not allowed.

categories.name: ASM (NG+)
categories.rules:
## NG+

- NG+ = New Game Plus, meaning you may start from a file which has already unlocked anything you wish to use during the run.
- You must complete all story missions.
- Do **not** skip missions using the popup seen after failing a mission 6+ times.
- Missions may be done in any order.
- Skipping the introductory camera pan, done by using a pre-run setup, is allowed.
- Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game window, is not allowed.
- Framerate per second must be displayed for sub 1:15 runs. This framerate per second should not exceed 200 FPS.

categories.name: No Mission Warps
categories.rules:
## NO MISSION WARPS

- Complete all story missions in order.
- Do **not** warp to missions using the Mission Select option; this includes using the Mission Select option to skip cutscenes.
- Do **not** Main Menu Warp (quitting into the Main Menu and resuming game).
- Do **not** skip missions using the popup seen after failing a mission 6+ times.
- Restarting a mission after it has begun is allowed.
- Pre-run setups including disabling jump cameras and methods that skip the opening camera pan are **not** allowed.
- Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game 
window, is **not** allowed.
- Framerate per second must be displayed for sub 1:40 runs. This framerate per second should not exceed 200 FPS.

categories.name: All Tasks NLR
categories.rules:
## ALL TASKS NLR

- Complete all story missions, bonus missions and races.
- NLR = No Level Returns, meaning you may not return to a level after you have completed it. For example, you may warp from Level 2 to Level 3 to skip a cutscene, but you may not warp from Level 7 to earlier levels to complete missions or races with faster vehicles. Warping to previous levels to substitute main menu warps, such as warping to 4-1 after 5-5, is also technically a level return and therefore not allowed.
- Note that you may complete tasks in Level 7 after the final cutscene via skipping it or warping to Level 7 through the scrapbook if you fail final cutscene skip.
- Do **not** skip missions using the popup seen after failing a mission 6+ times.
- Pre-run setups including disabling jump cameras and methods that skip the opening camera pan are **not** allowed.
- Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game window, is **not** allowed.
- Framerate per second must be displayed for sub 2:15 runs. This framerate per second should not exceed 200 FPS.

categories.name: Bonus Game
categories.rules:
## BONUS GAME
* Complete 5 laps of each Bonus Game circuit.
* The 7 tracks may be done in any order.
* The direction of the circuits may be either anticlockwise or clockwise.
* All other drivers must be CPUs.
* You are allowed to use a save state, prior to the load screen of your first race, to cut down on load times


## TIMING
* Timing is done by adding the time for each track together.
* It is recommended this is done through the Manual Game Time feature in LiveSplit.
* Please leave RTA (time with loads) blank.

categories.name: 99% NLR
categories.rules:
## 99% NLR

* Complete everything required for 100% except the Lisa Ticket in Level 3. (The Lisa Ticket is not included as it requires a Level Return).
* NLR = No Level Returns, meaning you may not return to a level after you have completed it. For example, you may warp from Level 2 to Level 3 to skip a cutscene, but you may not warp from Level 7 to earlier levels to complete missions or races with faster vehicles. This includes being unable to warp to 4-1 after 5-5.
* Note that you may continue making progress towards 99% in Level 7 after the final cutscene via skipping it or warping to Level 7 through the scrapbook if you fail final cutscene skip.
* Pre-run setups including disabling jump cameras and methods that skip the opening camera pan are **not** allowed.
* Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game window, is **not** allowed.

categories.name: Bonus Game
categories.rules:
## BONUS GAME
* The direction of the circuits may be either anticlockwise or clockwise.
* All other drivers must be CPUs.

## TIMING
* It is recommended this is done through the Manual Game Time feature in LiveSplit.
* Please leave RTA (time with loads) blank.

## 1 LAP
* The in game timer under "fastest lap" will determine your time

categories.name: All Story Missions
categories.rules:
## ALL STORY MISSIONS

- Complete all story missions in order.
- **Do not** skip missions using the popup seen after failing a mission 6+ times.
- Pre-run setups including disabling jump cameras and methods that skip the opening camera pan are **not** allowed.
- Timeskip, which is performed by mouse clicking on the game window, is **not** allowed.
- Framerate per second must be displayed for sub 1:25 runs. This framerate per second should not exceed 200 FPS.

games.name: The Simpsons: Hit & Run
games.rules:
## RULES

- Permanent video proof must be provided for all runs. This means Twitch past broadcasts will not be accepted as they expire after a set amount of time (note that Twitch highlights are still fine).
- Timeskip and changing the game's frame rate during runs is not allowed in Restricted categories. 
- Do not change single core priority on/off during runs.
- **All PC runs are subjected to displaying an FPS counter from listed time gates displayed in each main categories rules. Otherwise FPS counter is required for all podium submissions** (1st-4th).
- All runs on console must be ran using the disc. This means no runs with the game being loaded directly from the hard drive via a modded console.
- You may not use skips that rely on hardware to deload game areas.
- Use of in-game cheats is banned.

## TIMING

- Both LRT (time without loads) and RTA (time with loads) should be provided for submissions.
- Timing starts when pressing New Game or loading a tutorial save with Resume Game. If a tutorial save is used, the timer should start at 40.9 seconds (done automatically by the autosplitter). If you are using tutorial save on console, you must start the timer at 39.34.
- Timing ends when the icons reappear on the minimap after the last mission is completed. If you are running 100% and do not end on a mission, timing ends when 100% is acquired.
- Submitting LRT (time without loads) is not required for submissions, but it is preferred, as it is the main timing method used.
- If you are submitting a console run, leave LRT blank.
- All runs submitting LRT should show proof of LRT from using the LiveSplit timer and comparing against Game Time.
- Milliseconds should not be submitted for categories other than Bonus Game. 

## MODIFICATION WHITELIST

- A whitelist of mods that are acceptable for runs can be found here: https://www.speedrun.com/shar/thread/e9geo. All other modifications are banned.
